name: Cannibals
description: Tribal humanoids of the Cannibal Plains and Darkfinger, also called the Painted Tribe, who roam as far as the Great Desert. They carry the unconscious back to their villages, cage them, and beat them to death for the cooking pits. They do not eat Skeletons or animals, and like Skeletons and Hivers they are immune to acid. Scholars of the Machinists suspect they are humans who degenerated long ago.
